title: src/CLAUDE.md claims routeGap test 'asserts every route in AMMRoutes.json passes' but the test parses two hard-coded keys; a newly added route is not asserted
function: AMM Route Configuration > Adding new routes
fingerprintBasis: src/CLAUDE.md:AMM Route Configuration > Adding new routes:DOC-OVERSTATES-TEST-COVERAGE
description: src/CLAUDE.md:258 (added by story-052, Decision 6) states: "`test/unit/CurveAMMAdapter.routeGap.t.sol` asserts every route in this file passes; add a case there when adding a Curve route." test_routeGap_canonicalAMMRoutesAccepted (:368-382) parses two hard-coded keys, 'USDe-sUSDe' and 'sUSDe-USDe'; it does not enumerate the file. The story's own criterion (both routes pass) is met; the CLAUDE.md sentence claims a stronger, enumerating guarantee that does not hold.
impact: None directly (documentation/test-coverage deviation). Matters most for routes set on the live adapter 0x2D02, which lacks the validator (L-30).
recommendation: Reword to 'asserts both canonical USDe<->sUSDe routes pass', or iterate vm.parseJsonKeys over .Curve.RouterNG.routes.
escalationTrigger: Re-weigh to Low if a route is added to AMMRoutes.json and deployed without the test asserting it.
disclose: M-05 (ryv18m5, formerly L-30 DEDUP-18-03): enumeration hardening absorbed into M-05 recommendation (d)
